integrity: All-parameter combinatorial fixed-orbit proof; finite reproducibility checks enumerate q=2,3 and verify quotient orbit sums through q=5; finite checks alone are not the proof.
scientific_limitations: Determines only rational homology under the displayed Klein-four subgroup and rational orbit-space homology, not integral quotient homology, quotient homotopy type, or the full automorphism-group representation. The nonequivariant homotopy input is published, and there may be unindexed equivalent equivariant results.
title: The Klein-four homology character of \(\operatorname{Ind}(K_2\times K_q\times K_q)\)
